## Roll Call

Chair Winslow called the meeting to order at 6:01 PM.

Also in attendance was Alicia McNeil, Michelle Romero, Zach LeMel, Dan Grover, Charles Ranaghan, Maria Luise, and Councillors McDonald and Crowe.

Councillor Linehan was in attendance at the Economic Development Committee but stepped into Rules & Ordinance at 6:21 PM to participate in the discussion on Paper

**327-26.** 

Present: 5 - Stephen Winslow, Karen Colon Hayes, Peg Crowe, Amanda Linehan and Ryan

O'Malley

## Business

**327-26** 

Be it ordained by the Malden City Council that the Code of the City of Malden (MCC) 12.12.030 USE REGULATIONS is hereby amended as follows:

Sponsors: Ari Taylor, Stephen Winslow and Ryan O'Malley

Attachments: Current 12.12.030 Use Regulations Odinance

Proposed Sec. 12.12.030 Use Table

CCP 327-26 PB Recommendation

CCP 327 2026 PBR 8.26 wAtt

Presentation for Council 327-26 Updated Use Table Allowances_

Comment 327-26 Towing_Highway_Business_Request

OSPCD recommendations on Oct 13 for 327-26

Staff members from Inspectional Services and OSPCD reviewed and discussed proposed zoning changes to the Use Regulations table in MCC 12.12.030. Out of eighteen line items, there was agreement on fourteen.

Up for debate was Motel-Hotel, Restaurant Fast Food, Restaurant All Other, and Supermarket. Of these four categories, the Planning Board recommendation is to disapprove proposed amendments and create a Site Plan Review Committee to address the particular needs of these uses.

Regarding Restaurant All Other, there was much debate over the necessity of requiring site plan review. It was ultimately decided that this line item would not require SPR and was ready to be referred out for recommendation.

To avoid holding up the other fourteen categories that are non-controversial, a decision was made to split this paper. The fourteen line items from the original paper and Restaurant All Other were left in Paper 327-26 and referred out favorably to the Full Council for a vote to enroll expected to take place during the meeting of October 20. Needing further discussion Motel-Hotel, Restaurant Fast Food, and Supermarket were split into what is now numbered as Paper 327A-26 and tabled to come back to the committee at a later date.

A motion was made by Councillor Colon Hayes, seconded by Councillor Crowe, that the Ordinance be recommended favorably to the City Council. The motion carried by a unanimous vote.

327A-26

Be it ordained by the Malden City Council that the Code of the City of Malden (MCC) 12.12.030 USE REGULATIONS is hereby amended as follows:

Sponsors: Ari Taylor, Stephen Winslow and Ryan O'Malley

Staff members from Inspectional Services and OSPCD reviewed and discussed proposed zoning changes to the Use Regulations table in MCC 12.12.030. Out of eighteen line items, there was agreement on fourteen.

Up for debate was Motel-Hotel, Restaurant Fast Food, Restaurant All Other, and Supermarket. Of these four categories, the Planning Board recommendation is to disapprove proposed amendments and create a Site Plan Review Committee to address the particular needs of these uses.

Regarding Restaurant All Other, there was much debate over the necessity of requiring site plan review. It was ultimately decided that this line item would not require SPR and was ready to be referred out for recommendation.

To avoid holding up the other fourteen categories that are non-controversial, a decision was made to split this paper. The fourteen line items from the original paper and Restaurant All Other were left in Paper 327-26 and referred out favorably to the Full Council for a vote to enroll expected to take place during the meeting of October 20. Needing further discussion Motel-Hotel, Restaurant Fast Food, and Supermarket were split into what is now numbered as Paper 327A-26 and tabled to come back to the committee at a later date.

A motion was made by Councillor Colon Hayes, seconded by Councillor Linehan, that the Ordinance be tabled. The motion carried by a unanimous vote.

**415-26** 

Be it ordained by the Malden City Council that the Code of the City of Malden (MCC) Title 2, Chapter 24 is hereby amended by adding Section .075 ASSISTANT DEPARTMENT HEAD SALARY SCHEDULE and inserting the following positions:

Sponsors: Stephen Winslow

Attachments: Asst. Dept. Salary Schedule 415-26

Controller Ranaghan passed out the salary schedule to the committee, which was not originally provided when the agenda got posted. This document is attached to the history of Paper 415-26 and the body of the paper has been updated to include the salary amounts. These amounts go back two years retroactive because the city has been in negotiations with the Assistant Department Head's union bargaining unit for quite some time. On September 10 the city signed an agreement with Teamsters that included a 3% cost of living increase for FY'25 and '26.

A companion financial paper is required to make a transfer from the salary reserve account. The accompanying financial paper is expected to be ready to present to Council on the October 20 agenda and will then be referred to the Finance Committee. Off committee, Chair of Finance Councillor McDonald stated they are in favor of the R&O Committee to move this paper forward but they would need to review the financial obligation before they would be able to state if they are in support of approving the financial paper.

A motion was made by Councillor Colon Hayes, seconded by Councillor O'Malley, that the Ordinance be recommended favorably to the City Council. The motion carried by a unanimous vote.

## Other Business

As a result of ongoing discussions regarding zoning amendments in Papers 335, 335A, and 337, Councillor Winslow will introduce the option of drafting new papers to consider additional use regulation updates and/or dimensional controls necessary to Title 12. Subject matter may include, but may not be limited to, Motel-Hotel, Supermarket, and Restaurant zoning.

This topic of discussion was not taken up for business during the meeting of October 13, 2026.

## Adjournment

A motion was made by Councillor Linehan, seconded by Councillor Colon Hayes, that this meeting be adjourned. The motion carried unanimously. Meeting adjourned at 6:58 PM.
